name: Principal Inquisitor

generation.prompt: A cinematic, low-angle portrait of a Principal Inquisitor standing in a dimly lit, brutalist interrogation chamber. The figure wears a sharp, oppressive high-collar charcoal uniform with silver insignia denoting senior rank. Their expression is one of cold, calculating precision, eyes piercing through the shadows. A single, harsh overhead spotlight creates deep chiaroscuro contrast, casting long shadows and illuminating dust motes in the air. In the background, a heavy steel door and a single metal table. The mood is oppressive, authoritarian, and tense, with a muted color palette of slate grey, deep blacks, and cold sterile white. High detail, photorealistic, sharp focus.

gmNotes: Principal Inquisitor is Green's current IA title — a senior rank within Internal Affairs, above ordinary IA Agent. It records the office, not biology; the holder's Species is recorded separately on their character. Titles change: when a character's title changes, update the archetypes on their file. The title grants no automatic mechanics.
description: A senior investigator of the Internal Affairs — the one who asks the final questions when an inquiry will not close. The title carries weight in every court, and its holder is rarely turned away.
